summary: Peergos is a self-hosted platform designed for private file storage and management, supporting photos, videos, music, and documents. It also bundles collaborative tools such as a calendar, news feed, task lists, chat, and an email client within a single application.
goodFor: It suits users looking for an all-in-one, privacy-focused alternative to mainstream cloud storage and productivity suites on their own infrastructure.
watchOut: The lack of a tagged release in the version history and a moderate maintenance health score mean you should vet stability carefully before depending on it for critical data.
deployNotes: Because the application is built with Java, you will typically need to allocate sufficient memory for the Java Virtual Machine and place the service behind a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination and persistent storage.
